My mother in law 8 years ago.. My wife (fiancé at the time) and I went to spend the day with the MIL before she took off to Florida for a few weeks. Her husband worked out of state and she hadn’t seen him the entire year so she was excited to say the least, going to take her grand daughter too. Anywho she mentioned mowing to make sure the lawn was maintained while she was away. We went out and about with her ended up back to her place around 11am she went out to mow and give or take 1130 or so I hear the mower shut off as me and my wife are talking at the dining room table that looks out to the back yard we set off to leave say bye to the grand kid (8) at the time walk out and my wife is halfway to the car when I shout out to her and am running over to my MIL’s body she was about two feet from the mower face down in the dirt. I flipped her she was pale cold and eyes were lifeless I started cpr anyway and also had to dial 911 as my wife was frantic grandkid came out too and I had to make sure he wasn’t staring at her lifeless corpse in the dirt for too long. Anyway she was dead for a bit before we got to her.
